methodology: Deterministic coarse selectors over all K–5 catalog demonstrations and the legacy reviewed family plan. Candidate review tags are not validated learning requirements or runtime gates.
interpretation: No new readiness, coverage, live generation, automatic scoring, solvability or child-learning claim follows from this inventory. Components and examples remain freely composable subject to concrete capability/material/evidence validation.

universalMigrationGaps.need: Adapt existing local controls to typed owned world state and declared input/output ports; none of the v2 programs is connected to the current player.
Persist ordered accepted actions, revisions and assistance events, rather than only submit/next/hint snapshots.
Implement and version bounded trusted condition/effect execution with preconditions, invariants, atomic updates, replay and per-event limits.
Support persistent spaces, optional/branching goals and a stable finish contract separate from assessment outcomes.
Bind pending/reviewed judgments to immutable artifact versions, assessor provenance and the exact evidence criterion.
Add a separately versioned activity evidence channel and conservative learner-state reducer; current homework observations must not be rewritten.
Select the next learning intent from relevant assisted/unassisted evidence and uncertainty without making completion equal mastery.

operationExtensionReviews.need: Exchange equivalent quantities across named units/places while preserving value.
operationExtensionReviews.legacyLimit: bundle_builder exchanges exactly ten; quantity_lab moves scaled units but has no typed multi-place exchange operation.

operationExtensionReviews.need: Construct, revise, and inspect intermediate calculation states with place/operation identity.
operationExtensionReviews.legacyLimit: The workspace accepts one marks/text response; an open method is parent reviewed rather than a typed sequence of algorithm steps.

operationExtensionReviews.need: Manipulate rational parts with explicit unit/whole identity, including multiple wholes and mixed quantities.
operationExtensionReviews.legacyLimit: Legacy fraction controls require proper fractions and bounded denominators; split_compare preserves a proper bounded whole. Generic scaled counts do not provide a general linked fraction model.

operationExtensionReviews.need: Compose/decompose nonrectangular regions or pack unit cubes and preserve their spatial measures.
operationExtensionReviews.legacyLimit: area_tile/design/expression implement a rectangle; visible solid pictures and pointer strokes do not implement 3D packing or composite-region manipulation.

operationExtensionReviews.need: Move, rotate, reflect, partition, and combine typed shapes with measurable spatial relationships.
operationExtensionReviews.legacyLimit: Visible shape objects, generic marks, and freehand strokes exist; a general typed transformation/composition operation and automatic attribute proof do not.

operationExtensionReviews.need: Connect measured amounts through dimensioned units, scales, and valid conversions in shared state.
operationExtensionReviews.legacyLimit: Ruler/clock/balance/vessel boards exist, but unitLabel is display text; there is no general dimensioned-unit conversion type system.

operationExtensionReviews.need: Create/change a dataset and observe linked chart/table/summary representations.
operationExtensionReviews.legacyLimit: Current chart marks are a submitted scene state; no shared dataset object synchronizes multiple live representations.

operationExtensionReviews.need: Manipulate identifiable phoneme/grapheme/syllable segments and connect them to printed words and actual sound production.
operationExtensionReviews.legacyLimit: Word editing/sorting and real voice capture exist, but there is no typed sound-segment sequence or alignment operation. Pronunciation remains parent reviewed.

operationExtensionReviews.need: Attach parent-observed timing, accuracy, expression, and self-correction evidence to an actual recording.
operationExtensionReviews.legacyLimit: The app stores/replays a bounded clip and a final parent verdict; it does not align words/errors/timing or automatically establish fluency.

operationExtensionReviews.need: Select and relate multiple spans, claims, annotations, or text versions with explicit source identities.
operationExtensionReviews.legacyLimit: evidence_board selects one whole sentence from 2–8 sentences; generic text and sorting cannot provide a general multiple-span provenance graph.

operationExtensionReviews.need: Capture, organize, paraphrase, and cite notes that retain their source and selected evidence.
operationExtensionReviews.legacyLimit: Self-contained source material can be written into context and parent reviewed, but notes/citations are not first-class connected source objects.

operationExtensionReviews.need: Retain draft versions and observable revisions as skill evidence across a persistent editing experience.
operationExtensionReviews.legacyLimit: Saved draft_text can feed a later edit and each submission is retained; a typed revision/change lineage within a persistent editor is absent.

operationExtensionReviews.need: Assemble and edit bounded word/sentence/morphology pieces with stable identities and multiple accepted constructions.
operationExtensionReviews.legacyLimit: String editing and 2–6 ordered tiles exist; richer grammatical relationships and valid alternate constructions need semantic/parent review or a new typed operation.

operationExtensionReviews.need: Record concrete parent-observed collaboration, physical action, keyboarding, or sustained participation separately from correctness.
operationExtensionReviews.legacyLimit: parentParticipation and parentObserved are coarse flags, not a role/participation event model. A screen action cannot prove offline participation.
